lessons_2026_10_12: Visible early, earned later: the island is SEEN from the ground well before it can be reached, a floating island with its own silhouette over the cone, the arch readable as a sealed relic, signs in the world's voice telling an unqualified player why it is shut
No engineering looks: weathered, varied, built for Rayquaza (sky, ozone, old sky-pillar motifs); lanterns on posts, never light blocks

Flight is not gated anywhere in this pack (docs/world-building/WORLD_TREE_PLAN.md), so the gate is the ARCH's crossing and the encounter exists only for a qualified player; a player who flies up early finds a sealed, empty shrine
Memory: the one-shot geometry is a BUILD pack (cobblers_rayquaza_build, tools/pack_split.py) that reapply.py strip removes after the apply; the runtime pack is small
design.supersedes: KYOGRE_CAVE.md section 6 put the island in cobblers:pocket at (0, 4096). The 2026-10-12 lesson 'visible early' cannot be met by a pocket dimension, so the island is in the overworld over the great cone and the pocket island is not built. The pillar's roofed climb and the rescue survive in overworld form: the climb is inside the pillar, and a fall off the island is caught by Slow Falling instead of a teleport

arch.front_why: the player comes up the south ridge and walks north through the doorway, toward the island's shadow

plinth.why: the plinth's top is the median of the heightmap over its footprint; the summit dome moves 1-3 blocks over that footprint, so a cut or fill past these is a siting fault and the build refuses

sigils.why: three marks over the doorway: the sea's (Kyogre), the sky's (Rayquaza) between them, the fire's (Groudon). No light block: magma is a light source and was not used

island.size_why: KYOGRE_CAVE.md section 6: 'about 64 x 48'. The long axis runs north-south, so from Blaine's town in the west it shows its 64-block side
island.top_why: 64 over the summit (y304): high enough to read as floating from every side of the cone, with the underside's lowest point about 30 over the summit and 25 over the arch's top; the pillar's broken crown tops out under y415, 160 under the runtime ceiling y575 (data/world.json built_ceiling, cobblers_height)
island.satellites_why: four small rocks off the rim give the island a broken, drifting silhouette; `out` is blocks beyond the rim on that bearing (0 north, clockwise), `dy` from the island's top. Copper spires stand in for lightning rods: minecraft:lightning_rod is a spawn condition (data/spawn_blocks.json) and would draw strikes beside a dormant legendary

crown.coping_why: every wall column of the broken crown is capped with a 1.5-high wall block (palette.coping), so no wall top is a floor: from the crown's floor the lowest coping is 1.5 over the feet, which a jump never clears and an eye sees over. Without it the tops stepped up from the floor and walked off outward, 35-41 blocks onto the island, above the Slow Falling box; the box was not raised to cover them because one box from the cone to the crown would put every player standing on the island under Slow Falling all the time (the independent audit, 2026-10-13)

pillar.why: KYOGRE_CAVE.md section 6: 'a broken pillar 40 high; the climb is inside the pillar and roofed'. The climb is a helix of half-block steps between a solid core and the wall, ten blocks a lap, so it is walked without a jump on its outer side; it opens through the top floor onto the broken crown, where Rayquaza waits in the open

gate.why: the owner, 2026-10-06 (KYOGRE_CAVE.md section 9, answer 6): champion_cleared plus met Kyogre and Groudon. The met advancements are the chambers' convention (tools/legendaries.py: cobblers:legendary/<id>/met, data/progression.json quest.legendary_<id>.met). Groudon's is granted today by cobblers_legendaries. Kyogre's is being built in parallel (KYOGRE_CAVE.md sections 3-5): until a pack grants cobblers:legendary/kyogre/met nobody qualifies, which fails closed (contract C26). The design's sky tag (cobblers.sky, gym4_cleared) is implied by champion_cleared and is not checked

occupant.level_why: the owner, 2026-10-06 (answer 6). After the Champion the cap is 100 (data/legendaries.json level_caps), so it is catchable
occupant.properties_why: as tools/legendaries.py's chambers: `no_ai`, so it holds the crown. Moves, nature and item are trainer-balance-designer's to add
occupant.availability: once per player, keyed on the catch: a player holding cobblers:legendary/rayquaza/caught never makes it spawn or wake again; a qualified friend still can
occupant.nbt_why: data/sanctuaries.json's area bosses, unchanged: NoAI and NoGravity stay set awake, so it never flies off its crown
occupant.keeper_why: tools/sanctuaries.py boss_files' clock and guardian rules (C25), with three changes: the qualifying predicate is the gate plus caught=false, computed as player tags each pass; a dormant one is WITHDRAWN when no qualified player who has not caught it is within spawn_radius, so it never sleeps there for an early flyer; and the catch clock is short (6,000) because the catcher is excluded for ever by the advancement. A withdrawal sends it under the world before the kill so its drops (3-5 dragon's breath) cannot be farmed by walking away and back

messages.cross: The arch answers. The wind takes you up.
messages.sealed_league: The arch is cold. Its sky mark waits for one who has stood above the League.
messages.sealed_sea: The sea mark on the lintel is dark. You have not met what sleeps under the sea.
messages.sealed_fire: The fire mark on the lintel is dark. You have not met what sleeps under the mountain.
messages.wake: Rayquaza uncoils over the broken crown. The air smells of a storm that has not come.
messages.hush: Rayquaza will not answer while one the sea and the mountain have not seen stands on the crown.

rescue.why: a fall off the island lands 60-90 blocks down on the cone. Every pass, a player inside the box under the island (its footprint grown by `margin`, from 3 over the highest ground in it up to 1 under the island's top) gets Slow Falling, which in vanilla stops fall damage. Anybody standing on the island is above the box

palette.why: the sky arch's own palette (data/portals.json palettes.sky: mossy, cracked and plain stone bricks, cobblestone, a chiseled keystone) for the relic; a green, mossy island over the black volcanic cone so the silhouette reads; oxidised copper for the old weather instruments' patina. Every block is checked against data/spawn_blocks.json and refused if it is a spawn condition
